newsitem.title: USA: Kuhlman Corp to issues shares.
newsitem.headline: Kuhlman Corp to issues shares.

text.p: Kuhlman Corp said on Thursday it has filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission for the public offering of up to 2,500,000 shares of common stock.
This offering includes 150,000 shares which may be sold pursuant to an underwriters over-allotment option, Kuhlman said in a statement.
Net proceeds from the equity offering will be used to reduce debt, Kuhlman said.
In addition, the company intends to use a portion of the proceeds to redeem outstanding warrants to purchase 480,750 shares of common stock held by a former lender, the company said.
Managing underwriters of the offering are The Robinson-Humphrey Co Inc, Furman Selz LLC and PaineWebber Inc, Kuhlman said.
